definitions.gloss: last moment, eleventh hour, last-ditch situation
definitions.explanation: The very last possible moment before a deadline or decisive point. Often implies being pressed for time or backed into a corner.

examples.japanese: {土壇場|どたんば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンセル→キャンセル：06776_kyanseru⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was cancelled at the last minute.

examples.japanese: {土壇場|どたんば}になって⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The plans changed at the eleventh hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{土壇場|どたんば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧。
examples.english: She's the type who performs well under last-minute pressure and always delivers right before the deadline.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Historically, {土壇場|どたんば} referred to the execution ground — a raised mound of earth ({土壇|どたん}) where beheadings took place. From this, it came to mean a situation of final desperation with no escape.

USAGE:
Very commonly used in everyday Japanese to describe last-minute situations. Frequently appears as {土壇場|どたんば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (at the last moment) or {土壇場|どたんば}になって (when it came down to the wire).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土壇場|どたんば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンセル→キャンセル：06776_kyanseru⟧: last-minute cancellation
- {土壇場|どたんば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: strong under pressure
- {土壇場|どたんば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧: last-minute decision
- {土壇場|どたんば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧: to be pushed to the brink
